description: Choose which character sheet a series uses and which of its images is the main one. The main image is the reference every still of an episode is made from. Only your own READY sheets and their images can be chosen. Free. Requires the "video:create" scope.

assetId.description: An image id of that sheet to make the main image. Omit to keep the current main image.

name: select_character_image
title: Select a character image
